evidence_excerpts: Within this framework, mindfulness is described to reduce such biases through specific forms of mental training that develop meta-awareness of self (self-awareness), an ability to effectively manage or alter one’s responses and impulses (self-regulation), and the development of a positive relationship between self and other that transcends self-focused needs and increases prosocial characteristics (self-transcendence).
text: Mindfulness can be modeled as systematic mental training that reduces biased self-processing by developing self-awareness, self-regulation, and self-transcendence.
